title: 激光切割机3：材料
source_doc: course/Laser Equipment & Safety Training/03_Laser Cutter 3 Materials.md
author_source: project/Laser Equipment & Safety Training/03_Laser Cutter 3 Materials/src.py

points.K4: 每次登记，查实物和凭证
points.K9: 胶合板可以，密度板不行
points.K12: 成品件：写明可激光加工

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一张摆满木板、亚克力板、皮革和纸板的桌子后，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands behind a table covered with wooden boards, acrylic sheets, leather pieces and cardboard, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲：激光切割能用哪些材料。

shots.scene: 材料、标签、清单、工作人员四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a stack of sheets, a blank label tag, a blank checklist and a person icon at a desk. No people.
shots.narration: 选对材料、带好凭证、听从把关。

shots.scene: 阿杰抱着一块从家里拿来的旧木板和一块彩色塑料板走进创客空间
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks into a makerspace carrying an old painted wooden board and a colorful plastic sheet from home.
shots.narration: 阿杰从家里翻出一块旧木板和塑料板。

shots.scene: 阿杰兴冲冲地走向激光切割机
shots.prompt_en: The young male student heads straight toward the laser cutter with the materials under his arm.
shots.narration: 他想直接放进激光切割机里试试。

shots.scene: 小研在服务台前叫住他，指向空白材料清单
shots.prompt_en: At the front desk, the female graduate student calls him over and points at a blank materials list.
shots.narration: 小研叫住他：先登记，查材料。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 材料不对，激光切割就不安全。

shots.scene: 欣欣一手拿木板，一手举着盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a wooden board in one paw and a shield icon in the other.
shots.narration: 材料和安全，是分不开的两件事。

shots.scene: 两张空白课程卡，一张画着木板，一张画着盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Two blank lesson cards side by side, one with a wooden board icon and one with a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 这一课先讲材料，下一课讲安全设施。

shots.scene: 合格的板材放进机器，旁边绿色对勾
shots.prompt_en: A clean plywood sheet placed into a laser cutter with a green check mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 只有特定材料，才允许放进机器。

shots.scene: 方法正确加对的材料，盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a correct material and a correct procedure joined by a plus sign, leading to a shield icon. No people.
shots.narration: 材料对、方法对，激光切割就安全。

shots.scene: 火焰、异味、化学烟雾三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with yellow warning triangles: a flame, a wavy bad smell symbol and a chemical fume cloud. No people.
shots.narration: 材料错了，会起火、发臭、放出有害物。

shots.scene: 小研递给阿杰一张空白的材料清单
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands the young male student a blank one-page materials list with check boxes.
shots.narration: 场所会发一份激光材料清单。

shots.scene: 清单上一列材料图标：板材、亚克力、皮革、纸
shots.prompt_en: A blank list with a column of small icons: a wooden board, an acrylic sheet, a leather piece and a paper sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 能用什么、要什么凭证，都写在上面。

shots.section_title: 每次登记，查实物和凭证
shots.scene: 阿杰在服务台前登记，小研坐在台后
shots.prompt_en: The young male student signs in at the makerspace front desk while the female graduate student sits behind it.
shots.narration: 每次使用，先到服务台登记。
overlay: 每次登记，查实物和凭证

shots.section_title: 每次登记，查实物和凭证
shots.scene: 小研仔细查看阿杰带来的板材
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student examines a sheet of material the young male student has placed on the desk.
shots.narration: 工作人员要看材料实物。

shots.section_title: 每次登记，查实物和凭证
shots.scene: 标签、收据、订单确认三个空白图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a blank product label, a blank paper receipt and a blank online order confirmation on a phone screen. No people.
shots.narration: 还要看写明材质的标签或购买凭证。

shots.section_title: 每次登记，查实物和凭证
shots.scene: 不同材料旁各有一个空白检查表
shots.prompt_en: Different materials each with a small blank checklist beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 不同材料，查看的重点不一样。

shots.scene: 没有标签的旧木板图标打上问号
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an old unlabeled board with a big question mark above it. No people.
shots.narration: 没有标签、没有凭证的木板，

shots.scene: 从车库角落捡来的材料图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of random scraps from a garage corner, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 家里随手找来的材料，都不能用。

shots.scene: 小研摇头，把阿杰的旧木板推回
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student shakes her head and slides the old painted board back to the young male student.
shots.narration: 说不清是什么，就说不清安不安全。

shots.scene: 小研举起一张彩色亚克力板
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds up a colored acrylic sheet with a blank label on its protective film.
shots.narration: 亚克力最简单。

shots.scene: 标签、收据、订单上都有一个亚克力图标被圈出
shots.prompt_en: A blank label, a blank receipt and a blank order confirmation, each with a small acrylic sheet icon circled in green. No people.
shots.narration: 凭证上写明是亚克力，就可以。

shots.scene: 一摞木板和清单上的木种图标
shots.prompt_en: A stack of thin wooden sheets next to a blank materials list with wood grain icons. No people.
shots.narration: 木材，只允许用硬木。

shots.scene: 两种木板剖面，一种渗出树脂的被标警示
shots.prompt_en: Two wood cross-sections: one dense and dry, one with resin drops oozing out marked with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 硬木树液少，没那么容易着火。

shots.scene: 软木板切割后边缘焦黑粗糙的特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a softwood board after laser cutting, with charred, rough and uneven edges. No people.
shots.narration: 软木树液多，切出来效果也差。

shots.scene: 小研拿着一个写有木种的空白包装纸箱
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a cardboard box of thin wooden sheets with a blank label and a small square code pattern.
shots.narration: 包装上要写明木种，比如椴木板。

shots.scene: 包装上的方形码被扫描，弹出木种图标
shots.prompt_en: A phone scans a small square code on a blank label and a wood grain icon pops up on its blank screen. No people.
shots.narration: 能查到来源和木种的标签，也可以。

shots.scene: 小研从纸箱里抽出一张没有标签的薄木板
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pulls a single thin wooden sheet without any label out of the box.
shots.narration: 从箱里单拿一张光板，什么也没写。

shots.scene: 光板图标旁的空白凭证位置打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a plain wooden sheet next to an empty dashed box where a receipt should be, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 就算本身安全，没有凭证也不能进机。

shots.section_title: 胶合板可以，密度板不行
shots.scene: 一张层层分明的胶合板剖面
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section of plywood showing clean layered wood veneers, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 标明是胶合板的优质板材，可以用。
overlay: 胶合板可以，密度板不行

shots.section_title: 胶合板可以，密度板不行
shots.scene: 密度板和掺杂很多碎屑的板材被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A medium density fiberboard sheet and a particle board full of mixed chips, both crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 密度板、仿胶合板、掺杂多的板，不行。

shots.scene: 一块天然色的牛皮皮料，旁边牛的图标
shots.prompt_en: A piece of natural-colored leather next to a simple cow icon. No people.
shots.narration: 皮革，必须是真皮，也就是牛皮。

shots.scene: 皮料上的空白标签旁有叶子图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank tag on the leather piece with a green leaf icon and a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 还必须标明是植鞣的。

shots.scene: 另一块皮料旁的金属元素图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Another leather piece with a metal element icon beside it, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 铬鞣皮革不能用激光切。

shots.scene: 皮料标签空白、打问号，被推回
shots.prompt_en: A leather piece with an empty tag and a question mark is pushed back across the desk. No people.
shots.narration: 标签说不清，就不允许进机。

shots.scene: 几块光亮的人造革样品
shots.prompt_en: Several shiny synthetic leather samples with plastic texture laid on a table. No people.
shots.narration: 任何人造革，都不能放进机器。

shots.scene: 人造革冒出浓烟，过滤器图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of synthetic leather giving off thick fumes, overwhelming a small filter icon, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 它烟气多，现有过滤系统处理不了。

shots.section_title: 成品件：写明可激光加工
shots.scene: 桌上摆着大块亚克力板、木板和木砧板、木勺
shots.prompt_en: A table with a large acrylic sheet, a large wooden board, a wooden cutting board and wooden spoons. No people.
shots.narration: 不只是小板材，成品件也能加工。
overlay: 成品件：写明可激光加工

shots.section_title: 成品件：写明可激光加工
shots.scene: 木砧板的空白说明卡上三个图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A wooden cutting board with a blank spec card showing three check icons: a laser beam, a wood grain and a no-paint symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 说明要写：可激光加工，什么材质。

shots.section_title: 成品件：写明可激光加工
shots.scene: 刷漆和上色的木砧板图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a painted and a stained cutting board, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 还要确认没有上漆、染色等处理。

shots.section_title: 成品件：写明可激光加工
shots.scene: 只写着砧板的空白卡片被推回
shots.prompt_en: A cutting board with a nearly empty card showing only a board icon is pushed back. No people.
shots.narration: 只说是砧板，不够。

shots.scene: 卡纸、纸板、白纸一叠
shots.prompt_en: A neat stack of card stock, plain cardboard and white paper sheets. No people.
shots.narration: 纸、卡纸、纸板，也可以加工。

shots.scene: 带胶带和印刷的旧快递箱被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An old shipping box covered with tape, glue and printing, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 上面不能有油墨、污渍和胶。

shots.scene: 干净的纸板打勾
shots.prompt_en: A clean plain sheet of cardboard with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 干净的纸和纸板，凭证要求最低。

shots.scene: 小研在服务台前对材料做最后确认
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student at the front desk gives a final look at a sheet of material before approving it.
shots.narration: 能不能进机，工作人员说了算。

shots.scene: 天平图标偏向谨慎一侧
shots.prompt_en: A balance icon tipping toward a shield icon on the cautious side. No people.
shots.narration: 拿不准时，一律从严。

shots.scene: 阿杰点头接受，没有争执
shots.prompt_en: The young male student nods politely and takes his old board back without arguing.
shots.narration: 请尊重把关，不要争执。

shots.scene: 空白使用资格卡上出现暂停图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank access card with a pause symbol on it. No people.
shots.narration: 争执可能被暂停使用资格。

shots.scene: 欣欣翻开下一张课程卡，上面是盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot flips to the next blank lesson card, which shows a shield icon.
shots.narration: 下一课，讲设备上的实物安全设施。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现材料清单和凭证图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a blank materials list and a blank receipt.
shots.narration: 每次登记，带好材料和凭证。

shots.scene: 亚克力、硬木、胶合板、植鞣皮、纸板图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Five icons with green checks: an acrylic sheet, a hardwood sheet, plywood, natural leather and clean cardboard. No people.
shots.narration: 亚克力、硬木、胶合板、植鞣皮、纸。

shots.scene: 人造革、密度板、铬鞣皮、来路不明材料图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Four icons crossed out with red X marks: synthetic leather, fiberboard, a metal-tanned leather and an unknown scrap. No people.
shots.narration: 人造革、密度板、铬鞣皮，不行。

shots.scene: 服务台和天平图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a front desk with a person and a balance tipping toward a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 工作人员说了算，拿不准就从严。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰捧着一张干净合格的胶合板向镜头挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the young male student hold a clean labeled plywood sheet and wave goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 材料选对，安全一半，下次见！
